mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lottery_draw(draw_no, numbers, draw_time, total_bets, total_amount, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{drawNo}, #{numbers}, #{drawTime}, #{totalBets}, #{totalAmount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lottery_draw ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM lottery_draw WHERE numbers IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE lottery_draw SET numbers = #{numbers}, draw_time = #{drawTime}, total_bets = #{totalBets}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo}
